title: Jacques Vallee publishes his address so witnesses can send him UFO crash parts

tellings.quote: Jacqu Vallet publishes his address online so people who witness UFO crashes across the country can send him the parts

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have published his address online so that people who witnessed UFO crashes around the country could mail him the leftover parts. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the Stanford scientist Garry Nolan, who studies such material. It is told to show how physical samples of reported crashes reached researchers.
